name: Bug report triage
description: Severity, priority, component and duplicate detection for a new issue, with existing issues as candidates.

new_issue.title: Export to CSV silently drops rows with commas in the description field
new_issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create a project with a task whose description contains a comma, e.g. 'Fix login, then deploy'.
2. Go to Project > Export > CSV.
3. Open the file.

Expected: all tasks appear, description quoted.
Actual: the task with the comma is missing entirely. No error is shown. Tasks without commas export fine.

This affects our weekly reporting; we discovered it because the finance team's totals were off.
new_issue.logs:
[export-worker] 2026-09-18T09:12:44Z WARN csv_writer: row 17 skipped: unexpected delimiter in field 'description'
[export-worker] 2026-09-18T09:12:44Z INFO export complete: 41 rows written, 1 skipped

instructions.note: Severity is about impact on users, independent of how many users are affected or business urgency.

criteria.definition: Visual or wording issue; no functional impact.
Functional issue with an easy workaround; minor inconvenience.
Core feature produces wrong results or fails for some inputs; workaround is awkward or requires manual correction.
Data loss, data corruption, security exposure, or a core feature unusable for many users.
Service down, cannot log in, or data actively being destroyed; must be fixed before anything else ships.

has_repro_steps.instructions: Does new_issue contain concrete, numbered or clearly sequential steps that an engineer could follow to reproduce the problem, plus the expected and actual outcome?

component.instructions: Which component owns the root cause of new_issue?

export.covers: CSV, PDF and XLSX export pipelines, export workers, file encoding and escaping.
export.does_not_cover: The UI button that triggers an export (that is web_ui).

web_ui.covers: Browser front-end: layout, buttons, forms, client-side validation.
web_ui.does_not_cover: Correctness of data produced by backend jobs.

api.covers: Public REST/GraphQL API: request handling, auth, response schemas.

billing.covers: Plans, invoices, payment methods, seat counts.

instructions.task: Is new_issue a duplicate of one of existing_issues? Pick the matching id, or `none`.
instructions.rule: A duplicate has the same root cause, not merely the same feature area. Two different symptoms of the same escaping bug count as duplicates.

criteria.none: No existing issue shares the root cause.

priority.instructions: Assign a priority for the engineering queue, combining severity with business impact signals in the report (plan tier, downstream consequences, presence of a workaround).

criteria.P2: Schedule in the next one or two sprints.
